name: The Flight Plug
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve bob-length braids/beads, hoops, burgundy blazer, black top/jeans, white sneakers, silver laptop and blue/white tickets. Review stable ticket plane icons, no extra travel text, one suitcase trajectory, uninterrupted laptop grip and keying of blue ticket areas.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned woman with bob-length black braids and a few gold beads, large gold hoop earrings, burgundy blazer, black crop top, fitted dark jeans and white low-top sneakers. Preserve her open silver laptop held in her left hand and fan of blue/white boarding passes in her right. Tickets retain simple original airplane pictograms, without new legible names, flight numbers or destinations.
0–0.7s: full-body bright confident pose. She taps one key with her right index finger, then flicks THREE boarding passes ahead. A compact burgundy rolling suitcase floats up beneath one sneaker as she steps onto it, laptop staying open and level.
0.7–2.5s: camera accelerates beside her as the three tickets expand and fold into huge OPEN rectangular paper gates across thirty feet of cyan. She rides the suitcase like a bullet through all three, blazer tails and braids streaming. Each gate adds a visible bounded ivory/amber slipstream arc; the third wraps the suitcase and rider in a tight transparent wind shield made of separated tapered strokes with cyan gaps. A huge charcoal weight crosses their path, hits that moving shield and ricochets dramatically into the far distance with a dominant ivory impact star. Clear travel first, protection payoff second, no airport or ground.
2.5–3.5s: she banks sharply, the three ticket gates folding back down in her wake. Camera whips into her smiling face as exact title BOARDING PASS slams beneath her shoulders with a deep jet-like impact. Her laptop never closes accidentally or switches hands.
3.5–5s: entire character slows into a stylish pose beside the now normal suitcase. She catches the three normal tickets in a neat fan, closes the laptop with her left thumb, and nudges the suitcase handle up with her heel. A tiny ticket flutters late; she catches it between two fingers without looking. SFX: one keyboard click, paper flick, three escalating jet whooshes, giant shield ricochet, title slam, laptop clack and suitcase-handle snap. No speech, music, airline announcements or new writing.

params.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

name: The Street Apostle
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve brown skin, locs, open ivory coat with red/blue/yellow/black source graphics, bare chest, black wide trousers/boots and staff. Distinguish from sepia Asphalt variant. Review one-to-two seed relay, isolated plant forms on cyan, no landscape/soil or new floating glyphs.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact muscular adult dark-brown-skinned man with short thick splayed locs, bare defined chest, long ragged ivory coat carrying its original multicolored red/blue/yellow/black graphic panels, black wide trousers, heavy black boots and long brown staff. Preserve the colorful source coat, not the sepia variant. The fabric graphics stay fixed on the coat; no extra floating symbols or lettering.
0–1.2s: full-body low angle, staff held horizontally. He opens his palm to reveal ONE small brown seed, then strikes the butt of his staff against that palm with an emphatic controlled tap. The seed springs upward and one tiny bright leaf splits free. He sweeps the staff after it.
1.2–3.2s: camera races upward with the seed and pulls back as an immense twisting vine erupts from it, suspended entirely in cyan. He vaults onto a broad leaf and rides the vine's rising corkscrew while his coat fans behind him. At the top a gigantic closed amber seedpod swells to several times his height. He thrusts the staff forward; the pod bursts open with a huge bounded ivory/ochre pressure bloom and shoots exactly TWO seeds in diverging arcs far left and right.
3.2–4.8s: camera swings wide to show the full relay: those two seeds sprout into two colossal flowering vines at distant points, each opening its huge amber-and-crimson flower a beat after the first. Three connected escalating bloom impacts fill the composition with finite petals, curling dark-green leaves and small warm pollen sparks. The growth passes from one central plant to two others, clearly readable. Cyan remains visible between every stem and around all three isolated plants; no forest, soil, sky or full-screen glow.
4.8–6s: he swings his staff in a broad closing arc and the three vines bow inward, returning him on a single leaf platform toward camera. Exact title SPREAD THE WORD slams below his face with a deep woody impact. No speech, chanting or additional slogans.
6–8s: complete hero pose with staff, leaf platform narrowing to one small floating leaf below his boots. The huge vines shrink back into three seeds that land in his open hand. A tiny flower sprouts from his coat pocket; he glances down, carefully straightens it and resumes the stern heroic stare. SFX: seed tap, rising wood creak and foliage rush, central pod CRACK, two answering bloom BOOMS, broad leaf whoosh, title impact and three little seed clicks. No music or scenery.

name: Trap Vamp
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve locs, red eyes, fangs, black/red coat, bare torso, silver jewelry/crosses, buckled ripped trousers and platform boots. Review one persistent body, cape-only bat transformation, bounded crimson energy distinct from literal gore, clear drain return and title spelling.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult dark-skinned gothic vampire with loose black locs, glowing red eyes, small sharp fangs, long black coat with vivid red patterned lining, bare muscular torso, silver necklaces/cross pendants and rings, ripped black trousers with straps and chains, heavy black platform boots. Preserve his face, skin tone and jewelry. The action uses luminous crimson supernatural energy from ruby crystals, without people being bitten or injured.
0–1.2s: full-body low-angle menace. He slowly hooks one ringed finger under a silver chain and gives a fang-baring smirk. Three enormous faceted ruby power cores drift ahead at different depths. He releases the chain and snaps both coat tails outward.
1.2–3.2s: the coat lining unfurls into a colossal bat-wing silhouette thirty feet wide, still attached to his shoulders as flowing black/red cloth. Camera pulls far back and then accelerates with his explosive forward leap. A swarm of small sharply outlined black-and-crimson bats peels from the wing edges and spirals around the three ruby cores, leaving ample pure cyan gaps. Keep ONE continuous recognizable vampire body at the center, never transform his face or duplicate him.
3.2–4.8s: he spins through a huge crossing double-claw slash. The bat swarm strikes all three cores in an escalating sequence, splitting their outer faceted shells with three enormous bounded red/ivory impact stars. The released crimson light flows back in three thick twisting streams along the returning bats into his silver rings and chest pendants. The cores turn dull charcoal as he visibly powers up, coat snapping upward from the incoming force. Powerful drain and return, no full-screen smoke, no darkened background.
4.8–6s: snap close-up as the swarm folds back into his original coat tails and he comes to a poised stop. Red eyes flare once. Exact title PAID IN BLOOD slams below his collarbones, face clear, with a massive bass-and-chain impact.
6–8s: entire character in his confident reference-like stance. He casually straightens one silver ring; a last tiny bat arrives late and slips into the coat cuff. He gives that sleeve a faintly annoyed look, then flashes the fang grin again. All effects settle to leave an immaculate silhouette on cyan. SFX: jewelry tick, vast leather-wing snap, accelerating wing swarm, three heavy crystalline impacts, rising energy suction, dominant return boom, title slam and tiny final bat squeak. No speech, music or literal blood splashes.

name: Watson
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve short curls, trimmed beard, round gold glasses, brown pinstripe vest/trousers, rolled white sleeves, green patterned tie, brown shoes, magnifier and medical bag. Review one bandage path, mechanical patient repair, bounded protective wrap and clear anatomy within five seconds.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned doctor with close dark curls, short trimmed beard/mustache, round gold glasses, rolled white shirt sleeves, brown pinstripe waistcoat and trousers, green patterned tie, gold watch chain and polished brown shoes. Preserve the gold-rimmed magnifying glass and brown leather medical satchel with its existing red medical cross. No white coat or other costume substitution.
0–0.7s: establish complete kneeling doctor beside a slumped orange-and-brass clockwork training mannequin, its chest spring sagging and one arm loosely detached at a clean toy joint. He looks through the magnifier, then snaps open his medical satchel and flicks one roll of ivory bandage outward. This is a toy repair with no wound detail.
0.7–2.5s: camera races beside the unrolling bandage as it becomes a colossal continuous ribbon thirty feet long. It swoops in a huge overhead loop, retrieves the detached toy arm and coils around the mannequin from feet to shoulders with three sharp accelerating wraps. Each wrap pulls a loose mechanical part into place. On the final wrap its brass chest spring kicks back into rhythm and the mannequin rises upright. At that same instant a falling black iron weight hits the outer bandage loop; the loop stretches like a massive protective sling and catapults the weight far away with one huge bounded ivory/amber impact star. Recovery then protection, one clear continuous action.
2.5–3.5s: camera whips back to Watson's focused face. Exact title STILL BREATHING slams below his shoulders with the main bandage-recoil boom. He catches the bandage roll as the giant loose loop rewinds neatly into his hand; a tidy protective wrap remains on the repaired mannequin.
3.5–5s: whole doctor and upright mannequin on cyan. He checks the toy's now-steady chest spring through the magnifier, gives a brief satisfied nod, then catches one stray loose screw before it falls and quietly pockets it. Small dry comedy without losing his competence. SFX: bag latch click, fabric unspooling rush, three strong cloth snaps and mechanical repair clacks, steady two-beat spring thump, dominant sling recoil, title slam and tiny screw tick. No speech, music, hospital, floor or new writing.
